title: Tiramisu Rice Krispies Crunch
description: A creative dessert that combines the classic Italian flavors of tiramisu with the childhood favorite of Rice Krispies treats.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the Rice Krispies and cookies.
Melt the molten chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Pour the melted chocolate over the Rice Krispies mixture and stir until combined.
In a separate bowl, whip the whipped cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold the whipped cream into the mascarpone cheese until well combined.
Add the granulated sugar and vanilla extract to the mascarpone mixture and stir to combine.
Spoon the mascarpone mixture over the Rice Krispies mixture and top with additional cookies, if desired.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Cut into bars and serve chilled.
